tagline: Leading asset-light provider of transportation and logistics services
hero_kpi_rationale: The Expedited Freight segment represents 40% of consolidated revenue and is the historical core of Forward Air's business as a provider of regional and national LTL services.

kpis.name: Expedited Freight segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from Expedited Freight segment representing approximately 40% of consolidated revenue
kpis.description: Revenue from the Expedited Freight segment, which provides regional, inter-regional, and national LTL transportation services across the continental United States

kpis.name: Omni Logistics segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from Omni Logistics segment providing global logistics services
kpis.description: Revenue from the Omni Logistics segment, which provides global logistics services including air and ocean freight, customs brokerage, and contract logistics services

kpis.name: Intermodal segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from Intermodal segment providing drayage and container handling services
kpis.description: Revenue from the Intermodal segment, which provides first- and last-mile container drayage services to seaports and rail ramp terminals

kpis.name: Total shipment tonnage
kpis.explanation: Total weight of shipments in pounds handled by the Expedited Freight segment
kpis.description: Total weight of shipments in pounds, influenced by economic cycles, customer business cycles, and capacity conditions in the full truckload services market

risks.title: Economic recession and freight volumes
risks.score_rationale: Forward Air is sensitive to general economic conditions, particularly those affecting customer freight volumes and transportation demand. Recessions have historically caused cyclical fluctuations in the transportation industry. Declines in freight volumes could materially affect operating results.

risks.title: Inflation and operating costs
risks.score_rationale: Inflation increases operating costs including fuel and labor. The ability to raise prices to offset inflation depends on market conditions and competition.

risks.title: Customer concentration
risks.score_rationale: The company operates with significant and deep customer relationships. The loss of a major customer could have a significant negative impact on operating results.

risks.title: Transportation capacity shortage
risks.score_rationale: The asset-light strategy depends on the availability of third-party carrier capacity. The industry has experienced periods of capacity shortage that may constrain growth.

risks.title: Departure of key executives
risks.score_rationale: Management quality is critical in a high-touch service industry. The loss of executives with established customer relationships could impact performance.

risks.title: Fuel price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Although Forward uses indexed fuel surcharges, fluctuations can affect profitability and margins between adjustment periods.

risks.title: Strategic uncertainty and review of alternatives
risks.score_rationale: In January 2025, the Board announced the initiation of a comprehensive review of strategic alternatives. This uncertainty may affect employee and customer retention.

ai_positioning.summary: The company FWRD does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
